external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Users are either admins or viewers and sign in with an email address and password.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice link and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payer is not required to sign in.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who operates from the support office network and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users, which accesses tenant data, queues PDF jobs, and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app uses one database account for all companies and one service credential to fetch PDFs for all companies.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: It is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security. Protection at rest was not recorded.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: How the queue is reached was not recorded.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket storing rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs using one service credential for all companies. Protection at rest was not recorded.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app, including signing in and interacting with invoices.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.notes: The user signs in with an email address and password and gets a session cookie. There is no second factor.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customer information, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: access tenant data
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and saves tenant records in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and recorded user actions

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a PDF render job on the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.notes: How the renderer reaches the queue was not recorded.

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job. How it reaches the database was not recorded.

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries. How it reaches the bucket was not recorded.

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: unknown
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.notes: unknown
data_flows.data_description: invoice link containing an invoice number

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: The payer follows the invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: sign in admin console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Actions are recorded in the tenant database against the customer user, not the agent.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company tenant
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant boundary associated with each customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
trust_boundaries.notes: All companies nevertheless share one billing app, one database, and one PDF bucket.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform containing the shared billing app, database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
trust_boundaries.notes: The text does not specify network details within the cloud platform.

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data because it stores invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the database stores every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The render queue contains confidential data because its jobs identify a company and an invoice.
assumptions.basis: The description states that render jobs carry a company ID and an invoice number.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing invoice and bank-detail information.
assumptions.basis: The description states that the renderer writes PDFs to the bucket, and the payment page shows invoices and bank details.
